sources.title: 64-bit Models - Mikey's Retro FS Corner
sources.snippet: Lockheed L-188 Electra II for AI Traffic. This is a P3Dv4/5 (64-bit) conversion of the CPAI L-188 for AI traffic, with permission kindly given by Christian Page. This package contains base models only; but is compatible with any past or future repaints. Original aircraft by Christian Page, MCX and RADiator utilities by Arno Gerretsen, P3Dv4/5 conversion by Michael Pearson.
